revisions.stage: link inertials rotated Rz(90 deg) into the URDF joint frames
revisions.source: The SolidWorks export 'URDF THOR GEN3.SLDASM' defines joint axes along Y; Standard Bots' URDFs use X. On import, Rz(+90 deg) was applied to joint origins but not to CoMs or inertia tensors (shoulder through wrist_3; base_link's frame is not rotated). Reported by Brian Lynn, Slack #team-motion-planning, 2026-09-10 ('Spark and Thor Inertia Tensors and CoM's Incorrect'). Fix: sb PR #23043 'fix(urdf): apply Rz(+90 deg) to Spark/Thor inertia and strip wrist_3_cable_link inertial' by Lovro Ivanov, head 832dae36affafe4c7ab702be680c7d3225daddfb, OPEN (not merged) as of 2026-10-02. The PR states the error causes gravity-feedforward error up to ~6 N.m on Thor joint 1.
